title: Sesame, IVI RMA, and Costco Transform Fertility Care for Costco Members with New Partnership Offering Expanded Access to Quality Care and 80% Medication Savings
summary: Costco, Sesame, and IVI RMA have launched a fertility care program designed to expand access to specialists and help Costco members save up to 80% on IVF medications. This represents a major retail-healthcare partnership that could disrupt the employer-sponsored fertility benefits model.
